slides.texte_overlay:
behaviours that make you look
10x more attractive:

remembering small details about people.

their dog's name. their exam date.
they'll never forget it.

laughing at yourself.

confidence isn't taking yourself seriously.

putting your phone away when someone talks.

full attention is rare. and magnetic.

having a fun fact ready.

this morning i learned that audrey hepburn won an oscar for roman holiday.
the whole table wanted to talk about old movies.
